properties.name: cronctl.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the entire cronctl library. When false, no beans are registered and no endpoints are exposed.

properties.name: cronctl.scan.type
properties.description: Strategy used to discover @Scheduled methods. AUTO: all methods except @CronctlTask.Exclude. ANNOTATED: only @CronctlTask methods. PACKAGE: only methods in cronctl.scan.base-packages.

properties.name: cronctl.scan.base-packages
properties.description: Packages to scan when cronctl.scan.type is PACKAGE. Subpackages are included automatically.

properties.name: cronctl.api.base-path
properties.description: Base path for all cronctl REST endpoints.

properties.name: cronctl.api.public-access
properties.description: When false, authentication is required to access cronctl API endpoints.

properties.name: cronctl.swagger.public-access
properties.description: When false, authentication is required to access Swagger UI and API docs.

properties.name: cronctl.swagger.group
properties.description: Group name displayed in Swagger UI when multiple API groups are present.

properties.name: cronctl.swagger.paths-to-match
properties.description: Ant-style path pattern used to include endpoints in the cronctl Swagger group.

properties.name: cronctl.ui.enabled
properties.description: Enable the cronctl operator UI when Thymeleaf is available.

properties.name: cronctl.executor.thread-pool-size
properties.description: Number of threads in the async execution pool.

properties.name: cronctl.executor.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of tasks that can wait in the submission queue before returning 429.

properties.name: cronctl.executor.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Default execution timeout in seconds. 0 disables the global timeout. A task with timeout=0 inherits this value, timeout=-1 disables it, and a positive timeout overrides it.

values.description: Scan all @Scheduled methods. Methods annotated with @CronctlTask.Exclude are skipped.
Scan only @Scheduled methods explicitly annotated with @CronctlTask.
Scan only @Scheduled methods in packages listed under cronctl.scan.base-packages.
